title: Written Once, Read Differently How Language Models Own Answers Steer Their Next Ones
abstract: arXiv:2611.03198v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a language model answers a yes/no question, that answer changes how it answers a different question about the same entity. We study this \emph{self-commitment} in 22 open-weight models from four families (0.5B--72B parameters), fixing the model's first answer and measuring the shift in its second across 3,600 question pairs about 120 entities. Each answer writes a \emph{commitment direction} into the residual stream. The similarity of two questions' directions predicts their coupling on held-out entities ($\rho = 0.43$--$0.85$), and ablating a single direction shared across topics leaves at most 17\% of the effect in every model. How this direction is read is far less stable: the reading circuit spreads across more attention heads as models grow, instruction tuning makes more questions read it in the opposite sense, and in one model changing only the system prompt reverses the circuit's sign. translated_title: 一次写入，各异读取：语言模型自身的答案如何引导其后续回答
translated_abstract: 当语言模型回答一个是非问题时，该答案会改变它对关于同一实体的另一个问题的回答方式。我们在来自四个模型家族（参数量0.5B–72B）的22个开源权重模型中研究了这种“自我承诺”现象：固定模型的第一个答案，并测量其对关于120个实体的3,600个问题对中第二个答案的偏移。每个答案会向残差流中写入一个“承诺方向”。两个问题的方向相似性可以预测它们在留出实体上的耦合程度（ρ = 0.43–0.85），并且在每个模型中，消融这个跨主题共享的单一方向后，最多只留下17%的效应。然而，这一方向被“读取”的方式则远不稳定：随着模型规模增大，读取回路分布在更多的注意力头上；指令微调使更多问题以相反的意义读取该方向；在某个模型中，仅改变系统提示词就能使该回路的符号反转。在保留[……原文此处截断]的同时消融该方向……
tldr: 语言模型对是非问题的回答会通过在残差流中写入一个稳定的、跨主题共享的“承诺方向”来引导其对后续相关问题的回答，但该方向被读取的机制并不稳定，会随模型规模、指令微调乃至系统提示词而改变。
en_tdlr: Language models' own answers steer their subsequent responses by writing a stable, topic-shared "commitment direction" into the residual stream, yet how this direction is read is unstable—varying with model scale, instruction tuning, and even the system prompt.
